messages:
Liz: Heads-up — CipherWorks Dedicated rollout planned Thu 2026-04-02 01:00–03:00 UTC. Requesting SRE + Deploy signoff. Main pieces: model variant switch to quantized v2.4.1, KV cache priming, and a small telemetry tag change. No infra resize. Can we confirm KMS window doesn’t collide?
Devon: Release notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/releases/cipherworks/2.4.1 
Samir: Quick Q — what are the exact pins? fallback plan?
Liz: Pin: redwood-model-cipher-v2.4.1-quant. Fallback: redwood-model-cipher-v2.3.9-int8 (compatible). Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 220ms for 5m OR request error rate > 0.5% for 5m.
ops-angel: Need KV cache priming 30m before traffic shift. Suggest warmup to avoid cold-start spikes. Also we should lock autoscaler to steady for the window.
SRE-Alex: KMS team — not rotating keys that night, confirm. I’ll put a hold until 00:00 UTC rollback if anything changes.
Maya (PM): Product ack from CipherWorks: they confirmed quiet window and have run their smoke tests against staging. Good to proceed pending SRE/Deploy.
ops-angel: Warmup script (run 30m before shift):
```
./kv_warmup.sh --tenant cipherworks --keys 20000 --concurrency 8 --target-endpoint https://dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.internal
```
Liz: Deploybot, can we do a canary at 1% for 15m then 10% for 15m then full? Also please add a tag for the rollout: cw-20260402-quant
deploybot: [deploy] Canary started for tenant=cipherworks slice=cw-canary-01 at 2026-04-02T01:10:00Z. Version=redwood-model-cipher-v2.4.1-quant. Traffic=1%.
deploybot: canary metrics (01:25Z): p50=44ms p95=172ms p99=260ms errors=0.13% cpu=62% gpu_mem=73% :white_check_mark:
Devon: Noting: model binary size + quantized kernels landed in runtime-optimizations PR#7421. We should keep an eye on kernel fallback warnings in logs.
Samir: If p99 > 400ms we should consider immediate rollback — that's a hard fail for this customer SLA. Also logging collector needs the new telemetry tag or we’ll miss correlation.
SRE-Alex: I’ll watch the alerting: temp alert rule set 'cipherworks-deploy' -> latency/p95/err_rate. Ops will hold the manual rollback button.
deploybot: Traffic shifted to 10% at 01:30Z. Health OK.
Liz: If all green at 10% for 15m, escalate to 100% at 01:50Z. If any of the rollback triggers fire, ops will cut back to 0% and pin back to 2.3.9-int8.
Maya (PM): CipherWorks on standby for the 01:50Z full switch. They requested progress updates at +20m intervals.
Devon: Sending short release notes to customer now, will notify in their channel once 100% completes.
Samir: Ack on telemetry. I’ll deploy the collector config change in the 00:30 maintenance slot.
SRE-Alex: I gave the rollout runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/cipherworks-rollout — includes rollback steps, runbook snippets, and contact list.
Liz: Thanks team. Final asks: deploybot safe gates are set, warmup scheduled at 00:40Z, canary at 01:10Z. Please react with :thumbsup: if you’re good.
Devon: :thumbsup:
Samir: :thumbsup:
ops-angel: :thumbsup:
SRE-Alex: :thumbsup:
Maya (PM): :thumbsup:
deploybot: [deploy] Full rollout to 100% completed at 01:52Z. Version pinned to redwood-model-cipher-v2.4.1-quant. Post-deploy smoke: p95=185ms errors=0.11%.
Liz: Closing thread — will publish customer release note + postmortem checklist tomorrow morning. Great job everyone. :party_parrot:
